title: Plan, Watch, Recover: A Benchmark and Architectures for Proactive Procedural Assistance
abstract: arXiv:2606.04970v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Proactive multimodal assistants must decide when guidance is needed and what to say, while tracking progress through extended procedures and helping users recover when they depart from the expected plan. Progress is limited by benchmarks that score isolated clips, cover narrow domains, or omit realistic deviations. We introduce EgoProactive, a smart-glasses dataset of procedures across four domains in which users commit step-level deviations and recover from them, paired with reference guidance. We combine it with five re-annotated egocentric and instructional datasets to form Pro$^{2}$Bench, a cross-domain benchmark that scores intervention timing, procedure completion, and response quality. Zero-shot, no frontier or open-weight model completes more than 26% of a procedure's interventions before its first error. translated_title: 计划、观察、恢复：面向主动式程序化辅助的基准与架构
translated_abstract: 主动式多模态助手必须决定何时需要提供指导以及该说什么，同时在长时间流程中跟踪进度，并在用户偏离预期计划时帮助其恢复。当前进展受限于那些只对孤立片段评分、覆盖领域狭窄或忽略现实偏差的基准。我们推出了EgoProactive，这是一个涵盖四个领域流程的智能眼镜数据集，其中用户会犯步骤级偏差并从中恢复，并配有参考指导。我们将其与五个重新标注的第一人称视角及教学数据集相结合，构成Pro²Bench——一个跨领域基准，用于评估干预时机、流程完成度和响应质量。在零样本设置下，没有任何前沿模型或开源权重模型能在首次出错之前完成超过26%的流程干预。我们提出了PWR（Plan, Watch, Recover，即计划-观察-恢复），它在模型上下文中维护显式的计划状态并在发生偏离后对其进行修订（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了主动式程序辅助的跨领域基准Pro²Bench（包含EgoProactive智能眼镜数据集）以及PWR架构，后者通过在模型上下文中维护并动态修订显式计划状态，实现对用户偏离流程的及时干预与恢复指导，而现有模型在首次出错前能完成的干预不足26%。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Pro²Bench, a cross-domain benchmark (including the EgoProactive smart-glasses dataset) for proactive procedural assistance, and proposes PWR, an architecture that maintains and dynamically revises an explicit plan state in the model's context to enable timely interventions and recovery guidance, while no existing model completes more than 26% of a procedure's interventions before its first error.
